set.body: Consolidate responsive host f4acc6c and graphics batch checkpoint in an isolated candidate; retain prepared tile resources, present shared-device textures directly, preserve four-scale pixels and bounded ownership. Freeze original action p95 50ms/p99 100ms and scroll 100ms/200ms with existing 85 percent idle preflight. Preserve failed and refused receipts; one final quiet attempt only. Run required JVM/Native and desktop/GPU checks, record source hashes and evidence. Kernel semantics unchanged.
set.title: Integrate retained GPU tiles with responsive host presentation
